/titles/register.why: Read off the renders: the analysis pages (5 to 14) carry one- or two-line claim sentences in blue serif; the intro pages ask a question and the retrospective and nuclear pages name a topic. /charts.why: stacked bars order navy, blue, dark red, pink, green, grey with the legend set as coloured words above; line charts carry light grey gridlines and name series at line ends instead of a legend

/imagery/register_kind: one cover photograph in a wide slanted crop; otherwise none

/description.summary: A US government statistical outlook: white pages, blue serif claim titles, dense multi-panel charts with bold chart labels and unit lines, a source line under every chart, a solid blue footer band.
/description.typography: Times New Roman 26pt in bright blue for titles, one or two lines; Arial for everything else: bold 12pt chart labels with a regular unit line under them, 10pt body, 9pt axis and source text.
/description.color: White ground; bright blue 0096D7 for titles and the footer band; navy 003953, dark red 7A2630, pink, green and grey as series colours; grey for de-emphasised cases.
/description.layout: 16:9 at 10 x 5.625in; title top-left at 0.75in; one to three chart panels side by side across the width; source and note lines in the band above the footer.
/description.tables: Navy label column with white text, pale blue banded cells, thin white rules, no frame.
/description.imagery: Only the cover photograph and a logo.
/description.motifs: Full-width blue footer band with the page number at right; a dashed vertical line at 2025 marked 'projections' on every time series.

/derivation_rules: New series colours come from the six series roles in order; de-emphasised series take color.grey.
Emphasis on an exhibit uses color.emphasis (bright blue), drawn as a coloured label or line, never a filled box.
Sizes stay on the observed levels 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 18, 20, 26.

/continuation.why: none seen: no page of the 16 continues onto the next

/notes/fonts: Jost (cover title only) is not on this machine; the user approved Inter as its stand-in, measured about 13% wider. Arial and Times New Roman are measured with Liberation Sans and Liberation Serif.

/typography/roles/type.exhibit_label.why: bold black Arial chart labels over every chart on pages 4 and 7 to 15

/typography/roles/type.unit_line.why: the regular unit line set directly under each chart label

/typography/roles/type.body_large.why: running text on pages 2 and 3 and the table text on pages 5 and 6 at 14pt regular

/extra_roles/color.gridline.why: the light grey gridlines on every line chart (126 rule votes)

/typography/roles/type.cover_title.why: the cover title on page 1 is set in italic Jost in black at the title level
